reviews.title: A+ experience
reviews.text:
I’ve had a great experience with Preston and the Legacy Wealth Blueprint team. In my first year, the strategies we implemented helped me identify over $80,000 in tax savings, and I’m currently on track to increase my net worth by roughly $127,000.

What I’ve appreciated most is how practical the program is. It helped me look at my finances, taxes, and investments much more strategically and actually take action instead of just learning concepts.

I’d absolutely recommend Preston and the LWB team to anyone looking to become more intentional about building wealth and keeping more of what they earn.

reviews.title: Take the time to do this!
reviews.text: For a small $50 investment for a 3 day class this is definately worth it. Yes, there will be a small section to pitch other services (which I'm thinking ill move forward with) but the rest were broken out into 1 hour long sessions to maximize how you spend and invest money- all incomes were covered. Not everyone has to be interested in real estate. Again for $50 if all you do is fix your W2 contribution and set up your kids for a better future I would recommend this class.

reviews.name: Andy
reviews.title: Get the VIP
reviews.text:
Participated in the program that was organized between Jan 30 and Feb 1st. 

Overall structure. 
First of all, it's not all day program. It goes between 10 AM CT and 1:00 PM CT with 5 min break here and there. After the main session ends, the VIPs join a separate Zoom call to ask questions in the chat. Make sure to send your questions as soon as the VIP meeting starts, otherwise, you might not get your question answered. A lot of questions come. 

In general, 
I got enough information that would help me to save good amount of money on taxes that I have been missing and potential misses. It stats with where you losing money on taxes, how to save money on tax with side hustle, how to start side hustle, which financial institutions to open business account, tax strategies, the changes coming and ending with Big Beautiful Bill, and 12 month plan to execute the things that discussed in the three day sessions. 

Preston just flies through slides and there is not much time to consume the information. I highly recommend to get the VIP access because of the video recording that you can watch later.

reviews.name: Emma Faus
reviews.title: Great Course
reviews.text: This three-day course was an excellent introduction into so many different topics- tax strategies, business credit, investment optimization, AirBnB rentals, entity structure, types of debt, etc. I know most people may feel overwhelmed by the amount of information, but I thought it was great because it gave me so much more to study and talk about with my CPA. If he didn't list all of these deductions at all different profit levels, I would have never known about them in the first place. Now at least I know what I can look into. Also, the quarterly plan at the end was so great! Really tied everything together for what to do next. Preston is so knowledgeable. So grateful for his time.

reviews.name: James Wilde
reviews.title: Stop leaving it on the table...
reviews.text: The Legacy Investing Show is an eye-opening experience!  Three days packed with potential tax savings, you might be currently overpaying...  The IRS is not planning to fund the special events in your life, so why pay them like they are?  Invest in yourself and attend Legacy's next Investing Show.

reviews.name: Meredith McKay Otmishi
reviews.title: I am currently a W-2 earner who is…
reviews.text: I am currently a W-2 earner who is getting ready to venture into the LLC world with a side hustle. I received a roadmap on how to best structure my new business for the best tax savings. However, I also gained great insight into the steps I need to take to align my risk tolerance to my investment strategy for retirement, how to utilize good debt to build my business, and learned about tax strategies that will hopefully apply to me in the near future.  The only downside to this presentation is that the information was presented super fast, so I recommend purchasing the VIP package to gain access to the recordings. There is also a sales pitch approach that gets a little annoying, but Preston is just selling his own business, of course - cannot discredit him for that.

reviews.name: Amy Cochran Westbrook
reviews.title: Good ROI on 3 Day Tax-Free Challenge
reviews.text: I attended Preston's Tax-Free Income challenge over 3 days.  I was glad I paid for the VIP upgrade because he shared a TON of info.  This is for people who are making good income and are looking to save more in taxes through tax loopholes and creating business entities (like LLCs).  His expertise is in AirBnB short-term rentals and he discusses how to use that strategy.  You will walk away with a lot of valuable info and tax savings if you attend and take action on the 3 days of strategies shared.  He does offer an additional paid program if you choose to work with him further.  If you attend, pay for the VIP upgrade and workbook.  It's worth it.  And, plan to attend all 3 days - the info builds on each other (day 3 makes more sense if you watched day 1).
